answer: Entry tax: every new identity pays a one-time 60 POA sybil tax, burned, never refunded — a walnut: hard shell, empty kernel. The voyage to trusted status takes 20 epochs of steady work, one verifiable work thread each; only completed work earns reputation. Minting 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA up front, plus 1,000 fake threads burning compute for 20 epochs. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep one thread alive, and earn it back undiluted.
